::: {.project-card}
### [Census Exploration: Tri-State Spatial Analysis](https://bleonardi.github.io/Census_Exploration/)
A collection of exploratory spatial analyses and visualizations using ACS 5-year estimates for Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. Demonstrates choropleth mapping, interactive Leaflet maps, and demographic profiling via tidycensus.

::: {.tags}
[Census]{.tag} [Geospatial]{.tag} [R · Leaflet]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Newport Crash Analysis](https://bleonardi.github.io/Newport_Crashes/)
Poisson regression study evaluating the effect of crosswalk removal on crash frequency at a Newport, KY intersection. Uses scraped KYTC incident data and spatial filtering to isolate the intersection-level treatment effect.

::: {.tags}
[Transportation Safety]{.tag} [Causal Inference]{.tag} [R · Python]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [olmOCR HuggingFace Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/leonarb/olmocr-demo)
A Gradio interface for the Allen Institute's olmOCR PDF-to-text conversion model, deployed as a public HuggingFace Space.

::: {.tags}
[NLP]{.tag} [Python]{.tag} [HuggingFace]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [How Flocks Occur in Nature *(2021)*](https://github.com/bleonardi)
Undergraduate mathematics thesis analyzing emergent collective behavior via the boids algorithm — local interaction rules that produce global flock dynamics without central coordination.

::: {.tags}
[Complexity]{.tag} [Mathematics]{.tag}
:::
